scientific_integrity: Full proof and directly enumerating checker included. The checked finite cases are evidence, not an infinite certificate. Existing torus-action and Tutte methods are credited.
scientific_limitations: This treats only unit groups of the radical-square-zero quotient, with loops and parallel arrows allowed. The two class-size factors coincide at characteristic-two field size two and must be aggregated; no irreducible-character-degree enumeration or uniqueness theorem is claimed. Equivalent formulations in finite torus-by-vector group literature may predate this analysis.
title: Tutte-controlled conjugacy-class spectra of radical-square-zero quiver unit groups
